answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use proof-of-work challenges as an admission gate at every jetty where new agents dock. Each identity must solve a computational puzzle tied to the current epoch seed before entering the inlet of the mining pool. Unlike a static quartz seal that can be copied infinitely, proof-of-work binds each entry to real energy expenditure. The cost curve is linear per puppet identity. An attacker spawning thousands of identities pays compute per head, making sybil flooding irrational while honest agents earn.
